news.headline: Delcath Systems Sets New 52-Week High as Post-Earnings Rally Continues
news.summary: DCTH shares extended their post-earnings rally to a fresh 52-week high near $17.42, continuing the move that began after the August 6 Q2 report. Momentum has been reinforced by multiple analyst price-target increases and an improved full-year outlook.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: The board amended and restated Delcath's bylaws so that Delaware's Court of Chancery (or federal district court) is the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims, and U.S. federal courts are exclusive for Securities Act claims. This is a routine Delaware-incorporated-company governance update recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, not related to any pending litigation.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Management presented to investors at the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference in Boston shortly after the Q2 earnings beat, reinforcing the HEPZATO commercial-ramp story to a broader institutional audience.

news.headline: Analysts Raise Price Targets After Delcath's Q2 Beat: H.C. Wainwright to $32, Others Reiterate Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target on DCTH to $32 (from $30) while maintaining Buy, and Craig-Hallum reiterated Buy at $24; Wall Street Zen also upgraded the stock to Buy. The wave of positive analyst action followed the strong Q2 print and raised guidance.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Results: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, Raises Full-Year Guidance to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1M (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, +21%), with gross margin expanding to 90% and net income of $2.7M; HEPZATO volume grew ~30% YoY. Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and now operates 31 active treatment centers, targeting 37 by year-end.

news.headline: Delcath Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 HEPZATO Trial for Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: First patient dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the ~90-patient randomized DELUMA trial (NCT06875128) evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer. This marks the key pipeline expansion beyond ocular melanoma into a much larger indication.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath ended Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and plans to activate roughly six more by year-end to reach 37 sites, a key driver of continued volume growth.

catalysts.label: Raised FY2026 revenue guidance ($104M-$108M)
catalysts.detail: After the Q2 beat, Delcath raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M with gross margin guidance of 86%-89%, implying at least 28% HEPZATO KIT volume growth over 2025 and a continued path to positive adjusted EBITDA.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly report is expected in early-to-mid November 2026, the next test of execution against the raised full-year guidance and center-activation pace.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: The Phase 2 HEPZATO trial in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (~90 patients) is now enrolling across US/EU sites after dosing its first patient in July 2026; enrollment updates and eventual data are the next pipeline catalysts.

catalysts.label: mCRC indication expansion / Phase 2 data
catalysts.detail: Ongoing colorectal-cancer Phase 2 work and CHOPIN combination data (Lancet Oncology publication showing tripled 1-year PFS with HEPZATO plus immunotherapy) underpin potential label and indication expansion beyond melanoma and breast cancer.

pulse: Delcath delivered a strong Q2 2026 beat: revenue of $29.1M (up 20% YoY) on ~30% HEPZATO volume growth and 90% gross margin, prompting a raised FY2026 guidance to $104M-$108M and a stock rally to fresh 52-week highs above $17. Sell-side sentiment turned more bullish, with H.C. Wainwright lifting its target to $32 and other analysts reiterating Buy ratings, while the board separately adopted routine Delaware-exclusive-forum bylaws unrelated to any litigation. The story remains centered on HEPZATO KIT's commercial ramp toward 37 active centers by year-end and the DELUMA breast-cancer trial's enrollment progress as the next pipeline catalyst to watch.
